title: Elephant eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='27' ry='20' fill='#8f9bb3'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='55' rx='24' ry='14' fill='#a9b5cc'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='74' width='11' height='16' rx='4' fill='#7c88a0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='76' width='11' height='14' rx='4' fill='#98a4bc'/>
  <rect x='58' y='74' width='11' height='16' rx='4' fill='#7c88a0'/>
  <rect x='48' y='64' width='12' height='12' rx='4' fill='#b3bfd6'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M74 58 q8 -3 6 -9' stroke='#7c88a0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='42' r='18' fill='#a9b5cc'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='40' r='14' fill='#c0cbe0'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='40' rx='11' ry='14' fill='#8f9bb3'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='40' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#e0a9b6'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#3d4a66'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='35' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- tusk -->
  <path d='M20 50 q-1 6 4 7' stroke='#fdf3d0' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- trunk curling up to hold snack -->
  <path d='M14 46 q-8 8 -2 16 q6 7 14 3' stroke='#b3bfd6' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack: a peanut -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='63' rx='7' ry='5' transform='rotate(-25 30 63)' fill='#e0a35b'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='60' rx='4' ry='3' transform='rotate(-25 33 60)' fill='#f2c078'/>
  <path d='M30 63 q3 -1 3 2' stroke='#b57636' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
</svg>
